segments.sn46.21:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn46.21:2.3: “‘Bodhāya saṃvattantī’ti kho, bhikkhu, tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccanti.
segments.sn46.21:2.4: Idha, bhikkhu, satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ … pe …
segments.sn46.21:2.5: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.

lines: 202-203. Tatiyavaggassa paṭhame kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti bhante, kittakena nu kho bujjhanakaaṅgā nāma vuccantīti pucchati.

lines: 202-203. Kittakena nu kho kāraṇena bujjhanakaaṅgā nāma vuccanti bujjhanakassa puggalassa aṅgāti vattabbataṃ labhanti.
Dhammaparicchedo kathito gaṇanāmattena paricchinditvā vuttattā na bhūmantaraparicchedo, vipassanādiparicchedo vā.
